decision.rationale: The low8/high4 representation is byte-exact, aligned and fits the two-slot q32/O4 layout. M41 plus M338 independently reproduce the signed12 range and support the narrow definition. However, the runtime-weighted narrow count is not a sealed replay result, the new fixed stride increases DMA, and tile-specific compute reduction can expose tile1 DMA. Only a full M397-anchored recurrence can admit cycles.

identity.catalog_population: M73 disjoint DSEC train-only S32 over 18 sequences

legacy_m79_vcs_review.permitted_role: signed-lane codec design prior only; its 256-bit variable-width stream is not the M400 SHARED96 fixed-stride implementation

legacy_m82_vcs_review.permitted_role: zero-bubble control design prior only; its 256-bit beat geometry is not M400

legacy_m133_dc_receipt.permitted_role: logic feasibility prior only; its 512-bit port, buffering and record protocol are not M400

encoding.narrow_rule: All 96 signed12 lanes are in inclusive [-128,127], equivalently every high4 nibble is the sign extension of low8 bit7.
encoding.wide_reconstruction: signed12(sign_extend((high4<<8)|low8)) lane by lane; all 16 high-sidecar padding bytes must be zero
encoding.narrow_reconstruction: sign-extend each stored low8 lane directly to signed12

dma.commands_per_nonempty_tile: one weight command plus one command per M397 maximal consecutive used-center run
dma.reason: Every selected center occupies and transfers its complete fixed 640-byte O4 record; narrow affects local SHARED96 issue only.

unchanged_m397_resources.matcher: q32 SERIAL16_II1 unless the separately reported M399 early-only/combined variant is selected

independent_static_numeric_audit.method: Read and SHA-check all four M41 I_KY_KX_O signed-int8 binaries, take the first 32 nested M338 centers for each of 1,728 operator/partitions, sum selected 16 source vectors into eight 96-lane signed blocks, and test low8 sign-extension lane by lane.
independent_static_numeric_audit.admission: Static codec/range plausibility only; no runtime frequency or cycle admission.

read_only_exploration_audit.why_plausible: The denominator exactly matches M397 PWP rows times eight blocks, the percentage divides exactly, M397 freezes the used-center occurrence count, and an independent static q32 catalog reconstruction finds 25.356% narrow blocks with the same maxabs 1089. Runtime center frequency can reasonably reduce the weighted fraction, but only full phase replay can validate the exact 24,586,812 count.

conditional_gate_arithmetic_not_performa.mandatory_exposed_cost_equation: one extra config beat per 17,280 phases plus (640-576)/32=2 extra tile0 data cycles per 549,754 used-center occurrence
conditional_gate_arithmetic_not_performa.combined_actual_earlyhit_requirement: 195,890 + newly exposed tile1 DMA + any named codec/controller bubble
conditional_gate_arithmetic_not_performa.warning: These are conditional bounds using an unadmitted read-only narrow count, not a new candidate-cycle total or speedup. Formal replay may supersede the count and every derived bound.

frozen_minimum_execution_contract.name: M400_H67_Q32_O4_EXACT_ELASTIC_PWP_REPLAY_R1
per_phase_offline_generation: Generate every q32 center's eight signed12 96-lane PWP blocks from the M41 source-term vectors in M338 partition order.
Pack low8 for all lanes; pack high4 nibbles into 48 bytes followed by 16 zero padding bytes.
Set one narrow bit per center/global-output-block only when all 96 lanes round-trip from low8 sign extension.
Pack 64-byte little-endian center patterns and the 32-byte center-major narrow bitmap into one 96-byte config record.
Prove exact wide and narrow lane reconstruction, signed12 range and padding before any cycle replay.

per_phase_runtime_replay.selection: Reproduce M397 q32 selected center, distance, strict PWP/fallback decision, correction work, used-center set and maximal runs exactly.
per_phase_runtime_replay.narrow_descriptor_counting: For each PWP descriptor and each of its eight global output blocks, look up the selected center's frozen block-local narrow bit; count separately for tile0 blocks0..3 and tile1 blocks4..7.
per_phase_runtime_replay.dma_counting: Count q32 used centers once per phase per tile, independent of descriptor frequency; transfer U*640 bytes per tile and retain exactly the M397 run command count.
per_phase_runtime_replay.config_cycles: 3 data beats + cmd32 once per phase.
per_phase_runtime_replay.nonempty_phase_cycles: config + matcher + seal1 + tile_dma0 + max(tile0_replay,tile_dma1) + tile1_replay + tail2
per_phase_runtime_replay.commit: 96,000 cycles per sample outside phase recurrence

required_variants.m397_anchor: fixed12 144-byte block, 576-byte O4 center stride, 64-byte config, original q32 matcher; must exactly reproduce 669,012,336 candidate cycles before any variant
required_variants.elastic_only: M400 160-byte block/640-byte center stride and 96-byte config with original q32 matcher
required_variants.early_only: M397 fixed12 layout/config/DMA plus M399 q32 distance-zero prefix1 early termination
required_variants.combined: M400 elastic layout plus M399 q32 early termination

mandatory_outputs: Static per operator/partition/center/output-block min/max, narrow bitmap and exact codec digest
Per phase U/used runs/PWP rows/correction work and tile0/tile1 narrow descriptor counts
Separate descriptor-frequency issue ledger and phase-used-center DMA ledger
Per phase tile0 replay, tile1 DMA, exposed tile1 DMA and tile1 replay timestamps
M397 anchor, elastic-only, early-only and combined component tables
Read-only expectation comparison for 24,586,812 narrow descriptors, 549,754 used-center occurrences and maxabs1089; any mismatch must be investigated rather than tuned away
Double-sealed analyzer, frozen contract, CSV/JSON, exactness receipt and cycle receipt

one_point_fifteen_gate.advance: Only a fully replayed variant at or below the ceiling, with every exactness/resource/traffic gate passing and independent hammer acceptance, may advance to RTL performance validation.
one_point_fifteen_gate.no_go: A miss may remain a useful composable microarchitecture result but cannot be called the selected 1.15 performance contribution.

negative_controls: Mark a block narrow when 95 lanes fit but one lane equals 128 or -129 and require exact reconstruction to fail.
Flip one high4 nibble or one narrow bitmap bit and require the lane oracle to fail.
Set one of the 16 high-sidecar padding bytes nonzero and require fail-closed.
Use a 576-byte or unaligned center stride and require address/capacity checks to fail.
Charge two rather than three config beats and require config accounting to fail.
Multiply PWP DMA by PWP descriptor rows rather than per-phase used centers and require the traffic denominator gate to fail.
Skip sidecar DMA for narrow blocks despite the fixed-stride contract and require byte accounting to fail.
Subtract aggregate narrow descriptors directly from M397 total without replaying max(tile0_replay,tile1_dma) and require cycle attribution to fail.
Treat a center as globally narrow only when all eight blocks fit, instead of using block-local bits, and require descriptor counts to mismatch.
Borrow M79/M82/M133 VCS/DC admission despite their different port/record geometry and require identity checks to fail.

vcs_codec: Exercise all signed12 codewords at every lane position, including -2048, -129, -128, 127, 128 and 2047.
Prove one-beat narrow and two-beat wide reconstruction with low/high stalls, output backpressure, bitmap corruption and padding attacks.
Prove consecutive service has no uncharged retire/start bubble; otherwise feed the measured bubble back into the replay.
vcs_controller: Update the q32 controller's hard-coded 576-byte PWP stride and old bases to 640/6240/38912 and three config beats.
Verify maximal runs, tile tags, fixed-stride addresses, narrow lookup, two tile-specific replay counts and fail-closed protocol behavior.
synopsys: Run 3 ns TSMC28 logic-only DC for the exact M400 codec/controller on one 768-bit SHARED96 service boundary; old 256-bit M82 and 512-bit M133 results are context only.
Require Formality for the mapped netlist and PrimeTime prelayout before using its common-frequency assumption.
Later bind real config/PWP SRAM macros and run SAIF/PTPX; fixed-stride capacity fit is not macro PPA.

findings.title: The runtime-weighted narrow count is plausible but unsealed
findings.detail: M397 proves the 16,971,357 PWP rows and 549,754 used-center occurrences, while M41+M338 independently reproduce maxabs1089 and a 25.356% static narrow catalog fraction. They do not prove that selected runtime descriptors contain exactly 24,586,812 narrow blocks. A full selected-center replay is mandatory.

findings.title: Aggregate issue savings are not aggregate cycle savings
findings.detail: The 640-byte stride adds two DMA data cycles per used center per tile and the 96-byte config adds one exposed beat per phase. Tile0 replay reduction can also expose tile1 DMA. Elastic cycles must use tile-specific narrow counts inside the finite recurrence; direct subtraction from 669,012,336 is invalid.

findings.title: No exact q32/O4 SHARED96 codec/controller RTL exists
findings.detail: M384 is hard-coded for a 576-byte stride and old addresses. M79/M82 use 256-bit variable-width streams and M133 uses 512 bits; none proves one/two-beat 768-bit SHARED96 service, the fixed 160-byte block, bitmap lookup or zero-bubble integration. Fresh VCS/DC/Formality/PT is required.

findings.title: Fixed-stride elasticity increases DRAM/PWP capacity traffic
findings.detail: The mechanism is issue-width elasticity, not compression: PWP stride rises from 576 to 640 bytes per center/tile, full q32 PWP reservation rises from 18,432 to 20,480 bytes, and config rises from 64 to 96 bytes. The slot still fits, but every byte must be reported.

findings.title: The exploratory elastic-only count still misses the frozen gate under an optimistic bound
findings.detail: Conditioned on 24,586,812 narrow tasks, subtracting only unavoidable config and tile0-stride costs leaves at most 23,470,024 total cycles removable, 195,890 short of the 1.15 requirement even before any tile1 exposure or codec bubble. This is a planning bound, not admitted performance.

findings.title: The combined result depends on unresolved q32 early-hit population
findings.detail: With tile1 extra DMA fully hidden and no codec bubble, the read-only exploration needs at least 195,890 eligible q16 exact-hit rows from M399. The actual requirement grows one-for-one with exposed tile1 DMA and control overhead.

findings.title: Block-local issue control needs bounded ordering state
findings.detail: A single descriptor fans to eight block-local narrow decisions across two tiles. The implementation must preserve accumulator order while mixing one- and two-beat blocks under backpressure; the bitmap and codec alone do not prove this schedule.

findings.title: No physical memory, energy or paper PPA follows from slot fit
findings.detail: The 26,720-byte slot is a byte-exact logical layout. There is no macro compiler result, bank conflict proof, routed timing, SAIF/PTPX, energy, full-network speedup or DATE headline admission.
